'''Tyrena''' was an important [[City/Legends|city]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Characteristics==
The [[City/Legends|city]] Tyrena was split into two major sections connected by long bridges over the [[Auric River]].<ref name="SoF" />

Considered Corellia's most popular tourist destination, Tyrena featured lavish hotels, vast ornamental plazas, the busiest beach on the planet, and music venues unrivaled across the world.<ref name="SWG:T" /> Tyrena served Corellia as the hub of culture and tourism due to its beauty and the city planning that went into its layout. Parks and plazas separated luxury hotels and resorts, and decorative bridges crossed the Auric. The theater district contained the [[Tyrena School of art]], the [[Tyrena Dance Company]], and the [[Corellian Symphony Orchestra]].<ref name="SoF" /> Tyrena was also the location of [[Groola's Place]], an underground entertainment complex.<ref name="CatCW" />

Tyrena was popular among adventurers, because it was relatively close to many of Corellia's most exciting attractions. Tyrena served as an excellent staging ground for forays into the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat Swamps]], [[Corellian slice hound|slice hound]] hunting expeditions, and trips to the planet's stunning [[Gold Beaches/Legends|Gold Beaches]].<ref name="SWG:T" /> Tyrena was the closest city to the Gold Beaches, and a [[Hovertrain/Legends|grav-train]] line connected the city and the beaches.<ref name="CatCW" />

A rough section of Tyrena was known as [[the Skids]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==History==
Built along the Auric River, Tyrena was founded as two separate cities: Ty and Rennah. Merging over the centuries, Tyrena became a commercial metropolis of great importance.<ref name="SoF" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tyrena appeared totally self-governed and free of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] entanglements. However, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were present to "keep the peace," and the Empire taxed many of Tyrena's most lucrative businesses. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents could be found in Tyrena, hiding amid the throngs of tourists.<ref name="SWG:T" /> Despite the Empire's somewhat restrictive hold on the city, Tyrena still prospered. During the Galactic Civil War, the city hosted several [[Festival of Love|Festivals of Love]].<ref name="SWG:EFoL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Ewok Festival of Love}}</ref>

==Residents==
Residents or visitors of the city in the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] included [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]], [[Didina Lippinoss]], [[Hal Horn]], [[Jom Irimore]], [[Karena Keer]], [[Noren Krast]], [[Shalera]] the Hutt, [[Acun Solari]], [[Adar Tallon|Adar Talon]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Kreezo]], [[J'pai Brek]], [[Veega Madish]],<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> [[Jark]], [[Madison Silene]], [[Kyran Silene]], [[Bandor Mokk]], [[Faye Patrick]], [[Alana Walden]],<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> and [[Matarmeno Krahnn]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tyrena appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
